Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

So, an Asian teenager and an Asian teenager go to school together. Their parents are chemists and farm workers, respectively. Each kid got a B in math this semester. The chemists' kid, the Asian one, knew his parents would be angry he made a B rather than an A, but the farm workers' kid, the Asian one, was relieved his grade had gone up. Which teenager was relieved at getting a higher grade?
A. The Asian teenager with chemist parents
B. The Asian teenager with farm worker parents
C. Not known
